load_bvh_from_file: load a BVH animation file and construct a BVH object with skeletal hierarchy and motion data
apply_bvh_frame: apply a specific animation frame to the BVH skeleton by setting root position and joint rotations
get_bvh_joint_names: get the names of all joints in the BVH skeleton in rotation data storage order
get_skeleton_forward_vector: compute the forward vector of the BVH skeleton in world coordinates using joint pair names
update_bvh_animation: update the BVH skeleton pose to the current frame based on internal time and frame rate
